items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Lyrics by Joseph McCarthy, Spanish lyric Clotilde Aziao Jr.

ctx.x: Lyrics by Joseph McCarthy, Spanish lyric Clotilde Aziao Jr. (Inaudible) by (inaudible).

Yeah. But you remember, some of those things was written before, but they probably wasn't printed until that time. I mean, that was an era when I came back -- in '42-'40 -- (inaudible) a lot of writing together.
